$comment: Origin of the HOLLOW SUN icons (decision D34). Generated nine at a time as 3x3 sheets on Scenario Pro (commercial licence) through the Scenario MCP: items on a transparent background, skills, passives and currencies as painted square tiles. Each sheet prompt listed the nine briefs below and ended with the shared style from scripts/hollowsun-art.json; no names of artists, games or brands. Cut into 128 px WebP; a unique item uses the icon of its base.
